OMP 18.4.3 system prompt templates
===================================

These files are unmodified test fixtures copied from the published package
@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent@18.4.3.

Copied byte-for-byte from the published package:

  system-prompt.txt   <- package/src/prompts/system/system-prompt.md
    sha256 4fe416fcb7336b6540e2a53352e8a1b1acfe63d6fa02f282895fa7df7657a297

  project-prompt.txt  <- package/src/prompts/system/project-prompt.md

The files keep the published bytes; only the `.md` extension became `.txt` so
the repository Markdown formatter leaves them untouched. The regression test
renders them with the test data and renderer in ../../render.ts. No host runtime
code, and no other file of the published package, is stored here.
